about_the_game:
[Game Overview]

You’re an ordinary college freshman eager to embrace youth on campus, but suddenly, every night, you’re assaulted by seductive attacks from mysterious female ghosts in your dreams! With your preferences twisted and tormented, you seek help at a shrine, only to be told you must subdue four malevolent spirits across the city to break the curse…

After infiltrating haunted locations, you discover these rumored evil spirits are alluring female ghosts!? Bound by their obsessions, they suffer and lose sanity, with hidden secrets behind it all… Use your wit and yang energy—only you can save them!

【Game Features】

✦ Detailed fully animated H-scenes

✦ 27 H-story segments

✦ Over 350 CGs with variations

✦ Richly varied animated H-mode

✦ Easy and simple puzzle exploration and side-scrolling tower defense gameplay

✦ Fully voiced female protagonist

✦ Fully animated female protagonist artwork

✦ Over 150,000 words of text

【Game System】

—Map Exploration Puzzle—

Players must explore haunted locations, gathering data on ghost sightings, behaviors, weaknesses, and secrets. Key information is automatically recorded in the Ghost-Hunting Manual. Use these clues to solve puzzles, break through the ghosts’ defenses, and seize the chance to infuse Yang energy ❤!

Be cautious during exploration, make choices carefully, and follow each haunted location’s rules. If your sanity drops to zero, you’ll face attacks from the ghosts…

—Easy Side-Scrolling Tower Defense—

During the ghost-heavy “Evil Time Slot,” you’ll face attacks from female ghosts and other wandering spirits! Use items to fend off attacks and summon shikigami with your essence. Form the strongest shikigami team to capture and convert wandering spirits into resources!

Survive a set time in tower defense, and the ghosts will leave as the ghostly aura fades. Defeat a female ghost, and you can enjoy thrilling Yang energy infusion time ❤. Each victory increases the next tower defense’s difficulty but may unlock more intimate interactions…

【Character Introductions】

Name: Yuko

Residence: The corner room on the fourth floor of an old Japanese apartment building

Known as the “White-Clothed Demon of the Fourth-Floor Apartment,” she’s actually a gloomy, introverted ghost. Inarticulate and very timid, she’s surprisingly easily startled and hides when emotionally hurt. Despite her efforts to conceal her feelings, the ghostly flames around her betray her thoughts.

She despises human contact and deeply distrusts three-dimensional humans. Yet, this reclusive ghost harbors an unknown secret hobby…?

Name: Camilla von Dracula

Residence: An abandoned hotel in the remote suburbs

Known as the “Blazing-Eyed Vampire Cult Leader,” she claims to despise the “ordinary human” protagonist, constantly pranking him since his arrival. She and her followers, who worship her and crave immortality, occupy an abandoned hotel, their bizarre and dangerous ways branding them a cult.

Seemingly omnipotent to her followers, she hides an unspeakable secret in her heart…

Name: Zongzong

Residence: A park infamous as a supernatural hotspot

Feared as the “Cold Park Evil Spirit,” she’s the city’s most infamous urban legend. In truth, she’s a dazed, silent, clumsy zombie girl, inexplicably wearing embarrassing clothing while hopping around the park.

Unable to grasp human concepts or behaviors, she often terrifies passersby with her actions, yet all her strange deeds stem from a single wish she’s held for a very, very long time…

Name: Hasepsu

Residence: A large museum that suddenly closed

A mysterious, enigmatic, intelligent, and powerful ancient queen awakens abruptly from her coffin. Ancient texts call her the “Beauty of World Destruction,” every gesture brimming with allure. In contrast, her husband, awakened alongside her, is timid, cowardly, and unambitious. When she gazes at her husband and everything around, her eyes always hold profound meaning.

Whether imprisoning the museum guards or raising an army of spirits inside to conquer the world, everything she does stems from a certain reason…

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains explicit sexual content and nudity involving non-human female characters such as ghosts and vampires.
All sexual acts are consensual and occur between adults.
Scenes depict oral sex and mutual sexual acts in various intercourse positions, presented in a fantasy and supernatural setting.
The game also includes mild horror and dark fantasy elements.
